Responsibilities of the Intern:

• Help develop and test algorithms that convert raw satellite optical data (L0) into calibrated and georeferenced L1C and L2A products.

• Work on key processing steps such as radiometric and geometric correction, geolocation, orthorectification, and atmospheric correction.

• Write modular, testable, and efficient code for operational pipelines.

• Learn how satellite optical imaging systems form images, including the role of optics, detectors, electronics, viewing geometry, and platform motion.

• Use this understanding to support calibration, correction, reconstruction, and product-generation algorithms.

• Study and model common sensor noise, detector variations, defective pixels, quantisation effects, and imaging artefacts.

• Develop and test methods to reduce these effects while preserving image quality.

• Build simple, physics-based simulators for image formation, sensor response, sampling, geometry, and noise.
